## Purpose
Describe the intended change and why it is necessary.

## Evidence
- [ ] Tests/verification run on the exact SHA (attach results), or marked NOT RUN / BLOCKED
- [ ] Documentation links and structured data checked
- [ ] No credentials, secret keys, or private patent-sensitive details
- [ ] Existing authorship, upstream licenses and truthful legal status preserved
- [ ] Impact and rollback documented
- [ ] Human owner review for material external or operational changes

## Risk / release level
E0 Design / E1 Specification / E2 Implementation / E3 Unit / E4 Integration / E5 Runtime / E6 Production (select only what is supported by evidence).
